title: Does the choice of inhalational anesthetic influence the incidence of postoperative pulmonary complications?
summary:
Postoperative lung complications worsen recovery after surgery and can, in the worst case, lead to death. For sustainability reasons, the predominantly used anesthetic at the University Hospital Düsseldorf was replaced in 2023.
This study investigates whether the occurrence of postoperative lung complications in adult patients undergoing surgery has changed before and after this switch. For this purpose, routine data from two distinct periods of time are compared.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
-inpatient stay
-elective surgery
-date of surgery between 07/01/2020 and 06/30/2022 or between 07/01/2023 and 06/30/2025
-surgical service: general/visceral surgery, orthopaedic/trauma surgery, vascular surgery, neurosurgery, gynaecology, urology
Exclusion criteria:
-cardiac surgery
-surgery of the lungs or bronchi
-pregnant or breastfeeding patients
-cases in which the occurrence of the primary endpoint cannot be determined
